# winui2-Microsoft.UI.Xaml

Windows Runtime (WinRT) APIs for 6 namespaces.

This package provides the following modules:

- `winui2.microsoft.ui.xaml.automation.peers`
- `winui2.microsoft.ui.xaml.controls`
- `winui2.microsoft.ui.xaml.controls.animatedvisuals`
- `winui2.microsoft.ui.xaml.controls.primitives`
- `winui2.microsoft.ui.xaml.media`
- `winui2.microsoft.ui.xaml.xamltypeinfo`

The WinRT APIs in it are those of version 2.8.7 of the
`Microsoft.UI.Xaml` NuGet package.

```
pip install winui2-Microsoft.UI.Xaml
```

Other WinRT namespaces are packages of their own, so install the package of
each namespace your code imports from.
